newsitem.title: CROATIA: EBRD to invest 18.5 mln in Hypo Banka Croatia.
newsitem.headline: EBRD to invest 18.5 mln in Hypo Banka Croatia.

text.p: EBRD, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, said on Monday it would invest 18.5 million kuna in Hypo Banka Croatia, a subsidiary of Austria's Kaernter Landes-und-Hypothekenbank AG.
"The EBRD will subscribe to 4,612 newly issued registered shares or 24.99 percent of the (HBC) capital," it said in a press release.
This is designed to enable the bank to increase its capital base and provide it with much needed funds for development.
The Austrian parent bank would retain 75.01 percent in HBC, the EBRD said.
Its equity investment is part of a strategy to support the country's financial sector. It was seen as key in "promoting the development of a healthy local banking sector".

"By supporting HBC, the EBRD is contributing to the economic integration of Croatia within the Alpe-Adria region and in the wider Europan Union market," co-director of its Financial Institutions Team, Kurt Geiger, was quoted as saying.
